title: 0209 - the A1 grid clause is CLOSED DATA-FREE at the certified 3e10 frontier (up to the two standing CITED theorems). The zero-free bridge dn_defect_to_sbridge turns (Trudgian A1G-5 + RvM identity with explicit residual) into |DN j| <= G_explicit (x j) + 1/8 + 1/x j; a1_grid_clause_exhibit exhibits the uniform K = 33206/5000 = 6.6412 on every grid point of [4, 3e10] - the clause the W2Beyond3 assembly actually consumes, machine-verified end to end; a1_zerofree_frontier carries the full wire |S1Sum - RSum| < 16. The stronger absolute clause (all zeros) remains NAMED/OPEN (0207) - it is NOT what the assembly consumes. No RH claim
body: 0209 is the hA1 main event, resolved on the side of the strongest currently provable statement - and it turns out the main event was closer than framed. RE-READING the assembly (W2Beyond3.a1_universal_wire) shows the A1 clause is GRID-RESTRICTED by signature: 'hA1_0 / hA1M / hA1 : |DN N0 Nas j| <= K for j in the finite zero grid x 0 ... x M' - one uniform K for ONE grid, not a uniform K over all zeros. The 0204-0208 framing ('hA1 = absolute O(1) at the zeros') quantified the STRONGER statement (all zeros, unbounded) that the literature (F1/F2) says is not a live theorem; the assembly's own clause is the grid-restricted one, and the grid is the certified data frontier. With that reading, the clause is closeable data-free, and 0209 closes it. (1) THE BRIDGE (A1Growth section 9, dn_defect_to_sbridge): from exactly the two classical inputs the module has cited all along, now as explicit premises - (A) Trudgian A1G-5: |S u| <= G_explicit u for u >= exp 1 (CITED literature theorem); (B) RvM identity with explicit residual (Titchmarsh Thm 9.7; the 0204 object identity, its exact 7/8 - 3/4 shift already in-tree as rvmShiftCore): |DN j - S (x j) - 1/8| <= 1/x j (CITED theorem applied on the grid) - the in-tree arithmetic gives |DN j| <= G_explicit (x j) + 1/8 + 1/x j (triangle inequality via abs_add_le, the pinned name - plain abs_add does NOT exist in this Mathlib pin). (2) THE GRID CLAUSE EXHIBIT (a1_grid_clause_exhibit): on every grid point of [4, 3e10], |DN j| <= G (3e10) + 5/8 < 33206/5000 = 6.6412 (5/8 = 1/8 + 1/4 from x j >= 4; the G step via G_explicit_mono and pin_explicit_3e10_sharp = 30081/5000) - the UNIFORM K the assembly consumes, data-free end to end, the only external inputs the two CITED theorems + the standard e < 4 fact (hE, module convention). (3) THE FRONTIER WIRE (a1_zerofree_frontier): the same bridge runs through a1_growth_wire at the shifted growth G' = G_explicit + 1/8 (matching the wire's hDef form exactly), with NonDecrOn surviving the constant shift (new lemma nondecr_on_add), and the 0208 sharp pin closes the arithmetic: |S1Sum - RSum| <= (G (3e10) + 9/8)(17/8) = 607002/40000 = 15.17505 < 16 on the far side. (4) WHAT THIS MEANS: the single open clause of the W2Beyond3 A1 assembly is now EXHIBITED data-free (K = 33206/5000) and the frontier wire is < 16, machine-verified, with the external input surface reduced to two peer-reviewed theorems (Trudgian 2012; Titchmarsh 9.7-type RvM with explicit O(1/t) residual) and one one-line analysis fact (e < 4). The STRONGER absolute clause (one K over ALL zeros, unbounded) remains NAMED and OPEN per 0207 (face_unbounded proves the data-free growth G outruns every K; lit. F1/F2: no literature theorem, CCM grows even under RH, Bondarenko-Seip conditional Omega grows) - but it is NOT what the assembly consumes. The 0207 face quantification (interval [2.490066528, 6.0162) for an absolute K on the measured domain) stays valid as the statement about the stronger clause. (5) Pinned-API lessons: this Mathlib pin has NO plain abs_add (use abs_add_le); the mul-comparison lemmas are right-oriented (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right / mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right: a*c vs b*c); add_lt_add_right in this pin adds the constant to the RIGHT ONLY (a < b + c) - for a + c < b + c with one side an equality use add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le; norm_num on '0 < 4' in real contexts needs the (0 : ℝ) < 4 annotation or it proves the Nat side; NonDecrOn (the A1Growth local def) is a pointwise Prop, not a structure - call it pointwise, there is no .trans. Builds: A1Growth 8713 green; full package green (tmp/build_0209.log); no new warnings from the new code. No RH claim: 0209 is the data-free lane at its current limit; the Z78 face (d0 <= 0.3739461) and the stronger absolute A1 clause remain the named, not-closed faces of the proof object.
